integrity: Infinite-family conclusions proved with explicit profile reductions and strict inequalities. Exact-rational finite checks are implementation checks only. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Simple unit-weight friendship graphs, exactly \(1\le k\le2m\) noise-free pinned leaders, unnormalized grounded inverse trace; no weighted or noisy-leader generalization. A related 2020 windmill-coherence work was not available in full text; priority uncertainty persists.
title: Exact hub-abandonment threshold for noise-free leaders on friendship graphs
